source.title: Molicel INR-21700-P42A Product Data Sheet version 1.7
source.digitization_method: Original PDF vector polylines and axis calibration; no fitting, smoothing, or invented temperature coefficients
source.limitation: Reference curves, not performance guarantee. Endpoint voltage differs slightly from 2.5V because plotted vector coordinates are approximate. No real aircraft calibration.

interpolation: Piecewise linear voltage versus discharged Ah; interpolate temperature voltage on union normalized capacity nodes, then integrate energy; never extrapolate temperature
